test_has_nulls_series: test the Series.has_nulls() method to check if a polars Series contains null values
test_has_nulls_expr: test the Expr.has_nulls() expression to check if columns in a LazyFrame contain null values
test_has_nulls_series_no_nulls: test that Series.has_nulls() returns False when the Series has no nulls
test_has_nulls_expr_no_nulls: test that Expr.has_nulls() returns False for all columns when no nulls exist in the DataFrame
test_has_nulls_series_parametric: test that Series.has_nulls() is equivalent to null_count() > 0 and is_null().any()
